scope.summary: Builds and deploys Power Apps model-driven app generative pages, creates Dataverse entities when needed, creates model-driven apps, generates React and Fluent UI code, deploys via PAC CLI, and verifies in browser. The `/app-builder` skill also ships a teardown path that deletes the Dataverse artifacts an App Spec declares — the app, security roles, dashboards, command bars, forms, charts, views, relationships, tables, web resources, global choices, and the solution.

bundledScripts.purpose: Node.js helpers for Dataverse authentication, table creation, column creation, relationship creation, record creation, solution creation, and Playwright MCP launch.

dependencies.name: Dataverse environment with schema creation permissions
dependencies.description: Plugin creates Dataverse entities, columns, relationships, and records. Requires environment with appropriate security roles and DLP allowing Dataverse usage.

dependencies.name: PAC CLI authenticated session
dependencies.description: Deployment and solution management require authenticated PAC CLI.

dependencies.name: Azure CLI (az)
dependencies.description: Used for Dataverse authentication token acquisition.

dependencies.name: Model-driven app creation permission
dependencies.description: User must have permissions to create model-driven apps and generative pages in the target environment.

exceptions: Current generated UI uses Fluent UI V9 rather than EDS. Need to document whether platform constraints require Fluent UI or whether EDS can be used.

blockers: Internal owner and support channel are not assigned.
Skills, agents, scripts, and MCP configuration are not reviewed against Equinor guidance.
Production-system interaction is possible by default through Dataverse schema creation, app creation, deployment, and browser verification workflows.

`/app-builder` ships `scripts/teardown-model-app.js`, which deletes the app, security roles, dashboards, command bars, forms, charts, views, relationships, tables, web resources, global choices, and the solution declared by an App Spec. It is dry-run by default and requires both `--apply` and `--allow-destructive`, and it only resolves artifacts the spec names rather than scanning the org, but nothing restricts it to non-production environments. Destructive-operation authorization and environment restrictions must be defined before any pilot.
Data classification ceiling is not documented.
EDS position is unresolved because generated UI currently uses Fluent UI V9.
Technology Radar status is unknown for Fluent UI and Playwright.

CodeQL: `scripts/lib/app-spec-doc.js` escapes `|` for Markdown table cells without escaping backslash first, so a value containing a backslash before a pipe corrupts the generated design document. Recorded for upstream fix rather than patched in the fork.

evidence.summary: Re-reviewed after upstream sync 2026-09-09 (model-apps v2.6.0). Major surface expansion: the new `/app-builder` skill authors whole model-driven apps (tables, relationships, forms, views, charts, security roles, sitemap) plus Business Process Flows, driven by a vendored headless `cds-maker-sdk`. It also introduces the plugin's first delete path, `scripts/teardown-model-app.js`, so this sync moves `scope.deletesAssets` from false to true. Six standalone Dataverse write scripts (create-table, add-column, create-relationship, create-record, create-solution, add-to-solution) were replaced by that SDK. `hooks/hooks.json` was added — the fork wires only write-safety, skill-validator, and icon-import hooks; upstream's telemetry hooks are excluded. A `feature-flags.json` gates preview capabilities (`custom-api`, `custom-telemetry`) default-OFF. Production write and delete scope grew materially; status remains `defer`.

Re-reviewed after upstream sync 2026-06-30 (model-apps v2.2.0). Added Open Plugins metadata (.plugin/plugin.json + marketplace entry), bundled report-issue workflow content, and PLUGIN_ROOT-aligned helper text in local-dev/eval helpers. No new production interaction beyond the 2026-06-09 review. Copilot manifest blocker cleared; remaining blockers unchanged.

Re-reviewed after upstream sync 2026-06-09 (v2.1->v2.2, commits c63949d and ff0d191). Adds an automated eval suite (run-layer-1/2 TAP runners + 10 fixtures), new local-dev tooling scripts (capture-fixture.js using node:child_process spawnSync to run eval runners; generate-page-manifest.js writing local package.json/genpage.d.ts), supported-dependencies.md, docs/architecture.md, samples 11 (kanban DnD) and 12 (dialog/overlay confinement), and rules 16-18 confining portalled Fluent surfaces. No new production-system interaction: new scripts are local dev/eval tooling. Blockers unchanged.
Documents Dataverse entity creation, app creation, React and Fluent UI code generation, deployment, and browser verification.

Deletes App Spec-declared Dataverse artifacts in dependency-safe order (app, roles, dashboards, command bars, forms, charts, views, relationships, tables, web resources, global choices, solution) using az-token authentication. Dry-run by default; `--apply` performs deletes and destructive operations additionally require `--allow-destructive`. Identity is resolved only from names the spec declares, so it cannot wildcard-scan an org.
Contains Node.js scripts that require security and behavior review before publication.

notes: Initial review record only. This record intentionally defers publication until detailed review evidence exists. Upstream v2.2.0 synced 2026-06-09 adds an automated eval suite, two new local-dev scripts (capture-fixture.js, generate-page-manifest.js), supported-dependencies guidance, and dialog/overlay confinement rules. The new scripts are local dev/eval tooling with no new production interaction, but enlarge the script surface that still requires formal review before publication. Upstream sync 2026-06-30 added Open Plugins metadata and bundled report-issue workflow content; the Copilot manifest blocker is now cleared. Upstream sync 2026-09-09 raises the plugin to v2.6.0 and adds the `/app-builder` whole-app authoring workflow backed by a vendored `cds-maker-sdk`; this is the largest increase in Dataverse write scope so far and should be the focus of the next detailed review. The telemetry stack shipped upstream for this plugin is excluded in the fork.
